scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name webapp
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute webapp-production --local --file=./migrations/d1/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute webapp-production --local --file=./migrations/d1/0002_phase2.sql && wrangler d1 execute webapp-production --local --file=./migrations/d1/0004_phase_d1.sql && wrangler d1 execute webapp-production --local --file=./migrations/d1/0005_phase_d2.sql && wrangler d1 execute webapp-production --local --file=./migrations/d1/0006_phase_d3.sql
scripts.db:seed:local: node scripts/render-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute webapp-production --local --file=./seed/seed.generated.sql
scripts.db:reset:local: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed:local
